newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Landslide kills six in Colombian squatter camp.
newsitem.headline: Landslide kills six in Colombian squatter camp.

text.p: A landslide killed six people and injured at least three others in a squatters' settlement in southwest Colombia early on Saturday, Red Cross officials said.
Rescue workers said huge piles of mud and rock destroyed two shacks on an illegally occupied plot of land on the outskirts of Cali, Colombia's second largest city.
A Red Cross spokesman said the disaster had probably been caused by waste water from the squatter camp seeping into the soil and destabilizing part of the hillside on which the settlement was built.
